main_body: Sci-fi building: a sloped panelled roof (rows 0-18) over a grey metal front wall with windows and a central door (rows 21-41), on a dark base (rows 41-44)
top_band: Roof surface from row 1 to row 17: light blue-grey with panel seams and vents, brightest at the front lip (rows 15-18). Orange eave at rows 19-20.
evidence: Down the middle column there is a tall roof band of about 16 rows with panel seams and vents, so it reads as a real top surface. A light lip at rows 16-18 and an orange eave at rows 19-20 mark the front edge. Below that is a 21-row wall. The windows have dark inset frames with sills, and the door is set into a dark recess with a hazard-striped threshold. The roof is not a thin rim and the wall is clearly present, so the contract is met.

style.evidence: The outline is a dark blue-navy that follows the material, and the roof has about four tones (light, mid, dark, deep) with seam lines. However, the roof panels and the wall slabs are large areas of nearly one flat colour, with only a few speckle pixels and seam lines. The Beodeul references have per-tile scallops, plaster speckle and stone-by-stone shading, so the candidate looks flatter and thinner next to them, with fewer colours per tile.
